AnchorReport.description: Do the fitted tournament windows, refitted, reproduce the calibration's abilities? Old against new.
AnchorReport.title: AnchorReport

flags.description: What to read before comparing it with others.

information.description: The Fisher information of the document's own evidence at ``theta`` (logits^-2).
information.title: Information

theta.description: The ability (logits) on the scale of the items or abilities it was estimated against.
theta.title: Theta

EstimateFlags.description: What to read before comparing a document's estimated ability with others'.

degenerate.description: ``"all_fail"`` or ``"all_pass"`` when the document failed (passed) every criterion in every placement: the likelihood has no interior maximum and the estimate rests on the prior. ``None`` otherwise.
degenerate.title: Degenerate

low_information.description: The document's own evidence falls short of the standard-error target.
low_information.title: Low Information

EstimateFlags.title: EstimateFlags

ExtensionRecord.description: One document added to a calibration.

calibration.description: The fingerprint of the calibration it was computed against.
calibration.title: Calibration

estimate.description: The ability on the calibration's scale (logits), its standard error and information, and its flags. An inserted document has no flag set: an insertion that fails a check is refused.

judgements.description: Digest of the judgement records it was computed from.
judgements.title: Judgements

record_key.description: Digest of the slot, the source, the calibration, the judgements and the estimate.
record_key.title: Record Key

source.description: ``"scored"`` (from its own rubric answers, items frozen: the posterior mean and SD) or ``"inserted"`` (from tournament comparisons, opponents frozen: the conditional MLE).
source.title: Source

ExtensionRecord.title: ExtensionRecord

description:
The documents score_documents or insert_documents added, and the anchor report.

Apply it with Calibration.extended. ``anchor_report`` is ``None`` for scored documents:
scoring recomputes no row of the calibration, so there is nothing to compare.
title: Extension
